title: Jev decision head: elements, features, serving
description: As a Plexus user, I want a JevScore to declare elements (sub-questions answered in the same single Jev request) and a decision model that turns element answers plus Jev's holistic answer into the final value and a confidence, so that scores can be fine-tuned from human feedback. Phase 1 covers the schema, feature extraction, question namespacing, and hand-authorable linear serving. Not included: fitting, calibration, optimizer integration. Definition of Done: specs pass with a mocked client; without elements or decision, behavior is unchanged.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Phase 1 implemented: elements and decision blocks on JevScore, plexus/decision_head (features, linear models, registry, decide/validate), namespaced question registration with conflict detection, direct JevScorecard instances no longer share a registry. 59 specs pass with a mocked client; live run of 40 items sent 40 requests and the hand-authored head reproduced Jev's choice. Left open until committed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added plexus/decision_head evaluate.py and fit.py with specs, and the experiment scripts under scripts/. Results and caveats are in the wiki at lab-notes/jev-decision-head/. Still uncommitted.
